blocks.text:
Boat transfer to Cartagena and then to the airport for your flight.

Over 10 days, you travel from cool, high-altitude Bogotá to the Caribbean Sea. You will remember Monserrate and the old streets of La Candelaria, Zipaquirá's salt tunnels, mist above the coffee-growing slopes, a hot-air-balloon flight, Cartagena's fortresses and the quiet water beside Barú's piers.
